properties.name: weakcrypto:config
properties.value: skill pq-crypto, 2 scouts, max iterations 400, build bbcd802706e4

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Phantom/Solana deep-link session encryption (secretbox between the dapp and the Phantom mobile wallet): encrypts outgoing connect/disconnect/sign-request payloads, decrypts Phantom's connect-success and signed-transaction responses. Symmetric AEAD — Poly1305 tag is PQ-safe; the quantum-vulnerable part is the X25519 key agreement feeding it (reported separately).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Solana Mobile Wallet Adapter association keys and session ECDH — the keypair whose public half is the association token, and the ephemeral pair that establishes the encrypted session with the wallet app.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Web3Auth session keypair (secp256k1): generateRandomSessionKey() returns the private key hex that both decrypts the Web3Auth key share (via the AES256CBC secp256k1 ECDH) and signs session authorization requests.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MWA v2 session-encryption key: 16-byte AES-128 key material for the AES/GCM/NoPadding session cipher with the wallet app.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum-style message hash for the Web3Auth session authorization signature (personal_sign compatibility).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MWA session cipher: AES-128-GCM (HKDF-derived key, 12-byte SecureRandom IV, 16-byte tag, sequence-number AAD) protecting all messages between dapp and wallet app.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Web3Auth (Torus) key-share encryption: decrypts the login share (containing the wallet private key) using the secp256k1 session key + server ephemeral key; re-encrypts data for session-timeout/MFA authorization.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Secure randomness for the whole SDK: ECDSA keypair generation (P-256, secp256k1), AES-GCM IVs, deep-link nonces, keystore salts.
